hooks.command: fp=$(cat | grep -o '"file_path" *: *"[^"]*"' | grep -o '"[^"]*"$' | tr -d '"'); if [[ -n "$fp" ]] && [[ "$fp" =~ \.tsx?$ ]]; then npx prettier --write "$fp" >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf '{"systemMessage":"Formatted: %s"}' "$fp" || printf '{"systemMessage":"Prettier failed: %s"}' "$fp"; else echo '{"systemMessage":"Hook fired — not a .tsx file"}'; fi
